records.title: Improving Neural Network Training by Decoupling the Magnitude and Direction of Weight Vectors
records.reason: This work decouples neural-network weight magnitude and direction during optimization and evaluates training convergence/quality. It is an optimizer/training intervention; it does not demonstrate inference memory, latency, throughput, quantization, or serving changes.

records.title: Measuring Biological Capabilities and Risks of AI Agents
records.reason: 主題は学習エージェント/安全/ドメイン固有応用などで、LLM推論の計算量・メモリ・遅延・スループット・量子化・serving改善に具体的に結び付かない。

records.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
records.reason: EurekAgent engineers scientific-discovery environments and evaluates autonomous discovery task outcomes. The contribution is agent environment/research workflow design, not LLM inference systems or a concrete resource/serving optimization.

records.title: In-DRAM Signature Generation Using Simultaneous Multiple-Row Activation: An Experimental Study of Off-The-Shelf DRAM Chips
records.reason: The paper experimentally evaluates simultaneous multi-row DRAM activation for signature generation on off-the-shelf chips. Its measured latency/energy concern a physical-security primitive and DRAM behavior, not in-memory LLM inference or the linked SSD/offload lineage.

records.title: KairosAgent: Agentic Time Series Forecasting with Fused Semantic Reasoning
records.reason: KairosAgent combines semantic reasoning and time-series forecasters with tool calls; experiments report forecast quality and end-to-end agent timing. The measured runtime includes task/tool interaction and does not optimize LLM serving; the application is time-series forecasting.
